name: tachyon
description: Read-only view of this PC's NVIDIA GPU: load, VRAM forecast, bottleneck, crash flight recorder and render job history.
long_description:
Tachyon is a lightweight, read-only NVIDIA GPU monitor for Windows. This extension runs `tachyon.exe mcp`, a local stdio MCP server, so Claude can answer questions such as *why is my render slow?*, *will this model fit in VRAM?*, *what happened before the driver crashed?* and *was this render faster than last time?*

- Seven tools, all read-only (`readOnlyHint: true`). Nothing can change clocks, fans, power limits, processes or files.
- Local and offline: no network access, no telemetry.
- Live data comes from the running Tachyon app with **Agent API** turned on in its Settings. Point this extension at that `tachyon.toml` below.

Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and an NVIDIA GPU with its driver installed.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: What the NVIDIA GPU is doing right now: load, temperature, power, VRAM, clocks, CPU and RAM, bottleneck, VRAM forecast, running job and last crash headline.

tools.name: get_bottleneck
tools.description: Why is it slow? The current bottleneck in one sentence with a confidence, the process involved and the readings behind it.

tools.name: get_vram_forecast
tools.description: VRAM use and trend: when it will be full at the current rate, the fastest-growing process and idle apps holding VRAM.

tools.name: get_processes
tools.description: Processes using the GPU with their category, VRAM and engine use.

tools.name: get_blackbox
tools.description: The last minutes from Tachyon's flight recorder (peaks, per-minute timeline, optional samples) and the last crash report.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Recent finished render jobs and GPU-busy sessions: duration, GPU load, fps, energy, peak VRAM, temperature and throttling.

tools.name: compare_last_run
tools.description: Compares the latest job (optionally filtered by name) with the previous run of the same job.

config_file.title: Tachyon settings file (tachyon.toml)
config_file.description: The tachyon.toml of your installed Tachyon (next to tachyon.exe, or in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Tachyon for winget/Scoop installs). Turn on Settings > AI agents > Agent API in Tachyon first; without it every tool answers that the agent API is off.
